title: Deeper and broader research: typed DXF reference semantics and converter handoff
scope: DXF handle/reference group-code roles and copy/remap semantics

sources.finding: 320-329 arbitrary IDs are not translated; 330-339 soft pointers, 340-349 hard pointers, 350-359 soft owners, and 360-369 hard owners are translated.
Typed references are maintained during copy operations; arbitrary handles are not translated; XDATA 1005 handles act as soft pointers.

Common entity fields distinguish optional owner-dictionary references, extension-dictionary hard ownership, mandatory BLOCK_RECORD owner, and material hard pointers; order is not a reliable parser contract.
DWG reference objects carry typed owner/pointer roles and support relative handle decoding; do not conflate DWG wire encodings with DXF group-code semantics.
The loader supports a bounded subset and excludes unsupported objects; resource renaming is planned/executed consistently as a batch.
The auditor repairs duplicate table handles and notes that references can break, so post-repair openability is not a proof that original graph identity was correct.

DWG is converted by a configurable external converter and then imported through importDXF; output existence is checked after subprocess completion, so qualification must record process status and validate fresh output contents.
